additional_info.subject: First Entry
additional_info.body:
Customer sent us new photos to be uploaded to the charger.
We already had a screensaver setup for two of their chargers "We.EV Ad".
They requested 1 photo to be changed, "2281_WeEV_1080x1920_V02", this was confirmed uploaded and updated.
It was deployed via SCB, and after 24 hours, the customer reported to us, the charger had not yet updated the images.
Please see attached that the correct screensaver image was uploaded, our technican then shows that it was still showing the old photo (old photo has price of $1,595, new photo is $1,895).
I tried again to update the image, but it again only showed the old images on the chargers.
I tried removing and readding the chargers to the screensaver configuration, but it still displayed the old image.
I then deleted the screensaver configuration, added the images and the chargers and then the news images come online with ~1 minute.
Is this expected behaviour? To need to delete the configuration? Rather than just updating? Please and review and inform us.
